services.name: Teens Martial Arts
services.desc: When you join one location, you can go to both locations! Both are absolutely wonderful! The teachers really care about their students and their successes, they help them become better versions on themselves and they LOVE what they do. My son loves going to karate, he started about a year ago with a language barrier..but he definitely didn't let that stop him 👍🏽💙 he faced his fears and had the courage to attend class and focus to be his very best. His confidence, strength and self-esteem has improved dramatically! He is one of the loudest in his class. And he definitely takes pride in that ha.
